$description: Token proposals for CodeSnippet (carbon-labs v12). Carbon has no syntax colours. Each role resolves to a Carbon tag text colour for now (the human's decision, 2026-10-27), so light is the 70 step and dark the 20 step: 7.7:1 or better on the v12 light surface and 12:1 on the dark. Moves to packages/themes at graduation, or is dropped if Carbon adds syntax tokens. Comments and punctuation use $text-secondary and $text-primary and propose nothing.

syntax-keyword.$description: Keywords (const, return, def). The blue tag text. Falls back to $tag-color-blue.

syntax-variable.$description: Identifiers that are not calls. The same blue as keywords, as drawn; a separate token so the two can part. Falls back to $tag-color-blue.

syntax-function.$description: Calls (require, gulp.task). The green tag text. Falls back to $tag-color-green.

syntax-string.$description: String literals. Carbon has no orange tag, so the Figma value (v11 Tag/Orange, orange 70 light and orange 20 dark) is proposed as the palette steps. Falls back to $tag-color-red.

syntax-number.$description: Numeric literals. The purple tag text. Falls back to $tag-color-purple.
